pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly shaped sub-polygonal patches with softened edge gradients. The spatial area of patches is highest on the central flank, decreasing in size toward the neck and extremities.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous network of cream-colored interstitial pathways. The topology features a high frequency of tri-coordinate junction nodes. Thickness is relatively uniform with minor narrowing at high-curvature patch boundaries.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: A low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated 1D contour along the dorsal neck, representing a short, stiff mane silhouette.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent, dark-pigmented, raised lesion is visible on the lower ventral-flank transition, exhibiting distinct textural irregularity compared to the surrounding pelage.
